finish_summary: The cart module violates its specification in several areas: bulk_discount_percent returns 5 instead of 10 for quantity 50; parse_coupon incorrectly accepts whitespace and case variations beyond the spec; shipping_fee ignores membership when subtotal ≥1000, returning 0 instead of 30; Cart.items() does not return a list of (name, dict) tuples causing indexing errors; removing more than existing quantity does not raise ValueError; total calculation for members and coupons is incorrect; adding an existing item fails to increase quantity.
